All modules

reflection

pages · 1.3.0 · aj-p-reflection

Reflections, a destination (v4 C3): the week read back as a booklet, one leaf at a time (the week, a leaf per note, the signed leaf), with Earlier weeks on a line by month below it. A note's foot opens Timeline on the days behind it (N entries) and carries its thumbs (Ask's mechanic). States: list, week (an earlier week, pushed), first (the first reflection: no trend, a Next week leaf), empty (the week so far, one leaf), rated (a note's thumbs down pressed, its form open; the booklet opens on its leaf). One render for every platform; desktop puts the masthead in the title block beside the page.

variantplatformmobile · tablet · desktop (default mobile)
variantstatelist · week · first · empty · rated (default list)
variantcontextscreen · walkthrough (default screen)
contentdatadata
statedefaultyes: list, the newest week's booklet and Earlier weeks
statehovern/a: a page; its controls carry their own
statefocus-visiblen/a: a page; its controls carry their own
stateactiven/a: a page; its controls carry their own
statedisabledn/a: a page; its controls carry their own
stateselectedn/a: a page; its destination is filled in the navigation (the leaf in view is the booklet's)
stateloadingyes: reflections-loading, the latest week's booklet leaf for leaf (six pages: the week's headline lines, each note's big figures, its picture in its own grid in bone, its words and foot in bones; the end leaf real), each leaf named "loading", and Earlier weeks' spine with a month and three weeks in bones; "Loading your reflections." announced
stateerrorn/a: the reflection has no error state in journal-website.html
stateemptyyes: empty, the week so far (one leaf)
